default data list

Source: R/datasets.R
base_data_list.Rd

List of eleven datasets used for projections. The default dataset in the MRC projection framework. Includes data for 201 countries and 7 religious groups over the period 2020–2100.

  • [data_asfr]. Dataset containing age specific fertility rates

  • [data_fertility_differentials]. Dataset containing fertility differentials

  • [data_migration_destination]. Dataset containing migrants destination data

  • [data_migration_rates]. Dataset containing outmigration rates

  • [data_births_ratio]. Dataset containing fractions of boys at birth

  • [data_population]. Dataset containing population size data

  • [data_structure]. Dataset containing religion structure of populations data

  • [data_survivability]. Dataset containing survival rates

  • [data_switching]. Dataset containing religion switching rates

  • [info_variants]. Dataset containing variants settings

  • [data_regions]. Dataset containing regional codes and names.

Usage

base_data_list

Format

list of data frames

See also

Other base_data: data_asfr, data_births_ratio, data_fertility_differentials, data_migration_destination, data_migration_rates, data_population, data_regions, data_structure, data_survivability, data_switching, info_variants

Examples

length(base_data_list) # 11 datasets
#> [1] 11
